sources.title: Return of the revenge of the COVID vaccine "spike" in your DNA - RESPECTFUL INSOLENCE
sources.excerpt: March 9, 2022 - Claims that COVID-19 vaccines “permanently alter your DNA” were resurrected recently

reasoning: The claim that mRNA COVID-19 vaccines alter or permanently change human DNA is scientifically false. According to global health agencies (including the CDC, WHO, and NIH) and molecular biology consensus, mRNA from the vaccines delivers instructions to the cytoplasm of host cells to synthesize the harmless viral spike protein, triggering an immune response. The mRNA never enters the cell nucleus, where human DNA resides, and the body rapidly breaks down and eliminates the mRNA within days. Furthermore, human cells lack the biochemical mechanisms (such as reverse transcriptase and integrase) required to convert mRNA into DNA and integrate it into the human genome.
title: mRNA vaccines alter human DNA
